name: Gym Bot
tagline: Daily gym and calorie log for lifters and HYROX racers, fed by wearable data
description: Log your training and your meals each day and it keeps the running picture alongside recovery numbers from your wearable. It renders a daily card stack so the whole week reads at a glance, suggests meals that fit what you are doing, and calls out the pattern when takeaway quietly becomes a habit.
author: rakshitaphilip
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
